facts.fact: TechnoMag lists Mozambique among 26 countries where Starlink is active now (mid-2026), with a Residential plan at MZN 3,000 a month, Residential Lite MZN 1,900, Standard kit MZN 22,000 and Mini kit MZN 12,800; the date is the article's publication date, as it gives no other.

note: Ookla median download 226 Mbps for Mozambique early 2026 is mentioned in the sale fact context only; not a separate fact.
